items.title: 2026 Dell XPS 14 Review: Premium Build, Stunning Display, and Powerful Performance
items.display_title: 2026 Dell XPS 14 Review: Premium Build, Stunning Display, and Powerful Performance
items.original_title: Dell XPS 14 2026 The Windows Ultrabook King Has Returned
items.summary: The 2026 Dell XPS 14 is praised for its premium build quality, featuring a zero-lattice keyboard and a 14.5-inch tandem OLED display with 120Hz refresh rate and 100% DCI-P3 color accuracy. Powered by Intel's Panther Lake Ultra X 7358H chipset, 32GB RAM, and 1TB SSD, it delivers excellent performance for productivity and casual gaming. The review highlights the 4K webcam's exposure handling and the option to choose an LCD display instead of OLED. However, the reviewer notes fingerprint retention on the OLED panel and a high price point. While not a dedicated gaming machine, it handles casual games like Valorant and Fortnite at 60fps. The XPS 14 is positioned as a strong competitor to Apple's MacBook Pro with M5/M4 chips, though it lacks the same level of ecosystem integration.

items.original_title: Intel Just Changed the Game
items.summary: This review compares Intel's new Core Ultra X9388H and X5358H processors in gaming, CPU performance, and battery life. The X9388H shows strong gaming performance with Intel Arc B390 iGPU, outperforming AMD in some benchmarks but lagging behind Apple's M3 and AMD's Ryzen 9 7945HX.
